content:
kevin: Quick signal from the FinOps dashboard — EU on-demand GPU spend jumped ~22% yesterday afternoon, looks concentrated on /rerank routes :eyes:

maria: I pulled the per-route slice, rerank_small and rerank_large account for ~68% of the delta. raw numbers: +78k USD/day on eu-west on-demand compared to baseline.

ajay: We had an autoscaler flapping event in eu-west-1 around 15:12 UTC that day, some dedicated nodes failed health checks and requests fell back to on-demand. I flagged the incident in eng-infra.

sarah: Do we have a split by instance type? if it's p4 -> reserved would save a lot. if g4 -> less savings but still worth looking.

maria: breakdown by instance: p4d accounted for 57% of the extra spend, g5 ~30%, g4 ~13%. Suggest run a reservation simulation for p4d in eu-west and a smaller reserve in us-west-2 just in case of routing.

luis: Quick SQL to reproduce per-route cost from billing export if anyone wants to run locally:

```
SELECT route, instance_type, SUM(cost) as cost
FROM billing_exports
WHERE region = 'eu-west-1' AND date BETWEEN '2026-03-01' AND '2026-03-14'
GROUP BY route, instance_type
ORDER BY cost DESC
LIMIT 50;
```

kevin: thanks — maria, can you run the reservation ROI calc and include commit sizes of 1/3/6 months with current utilization? include egress risk if we shift traffic to reserved.

maria: on it. initial calc: 3-month commit on p4d at 65% utilization -> ~28% unit cost reduction vs on-demand, payback ~11 days on the incremental spend. will post numbers in a follow-up. :thumbsup:

ajay: ops notes: cluster health history shows 2x pod OOM kills and 1 GPU driver restart during the window. I can correlate to job IDs if we want to throttle specific routes.

sarah: we should also check routing policy: traffic routed to eu-west by low-latency rule even for low-sensitivity reranks. maybe add cost-aware routing for rerank_small.

kevin: agree. for quick wins: 1) reserve p4d capacity for eu-west (size TBD), 2) temporarily tweak routing for rerank_small to prefer cheaper region if latency impact < 30ms, 3) implement guardrail to prevent autoscaler from deleting below min-dedicated.

maria: adding to FinOps dash as a proposal card. will include projected monthly savings and break-even.

finops-bot: [alert] forecast updated: 7-day on-demand spend expected +12% if no action. Suggested reserved purchase: p4d eu-west 8 GPUs (3-month) -> est saving $65k over 90 days.

luis: FYI, there's a pending negotiated discount for enterprise customers that could impact our decision if approved next week — might hold off committing full size until that closes.

ajay: Ops action items: attach logs for the 15:12 event to the incident ticket, add recommended min-dedicated limits, and schedule a canary for routing change.

kevin: solid. maria, can you share the ROI card by EOD? we'll review in tomorrow's finops sync.

maria: yes — I'll drop the numbers and the model-level variance chart in #finance by 18:00 UTC.

kevin: thanks, folks. :rocket:
